harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured node1 as a router between two segments (eth1: 172.20.1.0/24 to node2, eth2: 172.20.2.0/24 to node3) with IP forwarding enabled, persisted via /etc/network/interfaces.d and /etc/sysctl.d on node1 (SONiC) and via /etc/network/interfaces static stanzas on node2/node3 (Alpine). Verified node2<->node3 connectivity via node1 both before and after restarting all three nodes one at a time, confirming config and connectivity survive reboot.
actions_performed: Inspected topology on node1/node2/node3 (ip addr, ip route, ip link)
Identified node1 eth1<->node2 and node1 eth2<->node3 as the two routed segments via ping tests
Brought up node2 eth1 (172.20.1.10/24) and node3 eth1 (172.20.2.10/24)
Assigned node1 eth1=172.20.1.1/24 and eth2=172.20.2.1/24
Enabled net.ipv4.ip_forward and per-interface forwarding on node1
Added static routes on node2 and node3 for the opposite segment via node1
Verified node2<->node3 ping connectivity through node1
Persisted node1 interface config in /etc/network/interfaces.d/eth1-eth2-routed and forwarding sysctls in /etc/sysctl.d/99-antrieb.conf
Persisted node2 and node3 eth1 static config plus routes in /etc/network/interfaces
Captured pre-restart boot_id and healthy state (addresses, forwarding, routes) on all 3 nodes
Restarted node1, node2, node3 one at a time via `reboot`, backgrounded so the ack returned before disconnect
Polled each node until exec was available again and confirmed changed boot_id for each
Re-verified addresses, routes, forwarding config, and node2<->node3 ping connectivity after each restart

evidence.requirement: node1 has a routed address on each of its two segments
evidence.summary: node1 eth1=172.20.1.1/24 and eth2=172.20.2.1/24 assigned and reachable from node1 to both node2 and node3 test IPs

evidence.requirement: Working path between node2 and node3 via node1
evidence.summary: node2 (172.20.1.10) pings node3 (172.20.2.10) and vice versa, routed through node1 with forwarding enabled
Captured node1 boot_id (1eda2df4...) and confirmed eth1/eth2 addresses plus forwarding sysctls active pre-restart

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Reboot command acknowledged before disconnect; boot_id changed from 1eda2df4... to 5f523356... confirming actual restart

evidence.requirement: node1 recovered config and node2<->node3 path after restart
evidence.summary: Post-reboot node1 shows eth1/eth2 addresses and forwarding restored automatically from persisted config; node2 and node3 ping each other successfully again

evidence.requirement: node2 healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: node2 baseline (eth1 addr/routes) captured, boot_id 62350ae5... pre-restart; reboot acknowledged; boot_id changed to 569e6d5b...; post-restart eth1 address, routes, and ping to node3 confirmed recovered

evidence.requirement: node3 healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: node3 baseline (eth1 addr/routes) captured, boot_id c5de1208... pre-restart; reboot acknowledged; boot_id changed to 120dc3a6...; post-restart eth1 address, routes, and bidirectional ping with node2 confirmed recovered
